confirmedIssues.title: Manual poll acknowledgement is reported as completed price update
confirmedIssues.mechanism: POST immediately returns poll_triggered while detached worker execution is outstanding. The hook unconditionally says Gas prices updated and clears mutation pending on that acknowledgement. Later provider/DB failure is only logged/traced; the mutation cannot reject for it and status has no attempt/failure fields.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future isolated provider test: delay GetCurrentPrice or make it fail, acknowledge POST, and observe completed-success toast/enabled Poll now before any committed price change. No poll/API/provider test was executed here.
confirmedIssues.fix: Distinguish triggered from completed using the existing triggered copy; define an explicit completion/failure source before claiming updated or complete. Do not derive success from an HTTP acknowledgement.
needs: separately owned catalog/test changes only if required

confirmedIssues.title: New automatic or delayed manual prices do not refresh mounted history
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Only status polls every 30 seconds. History has staleTime but no interval or linkage to a changed last_poll_time; window-focus refresh defaults false. Manual history invalidation occurs at acknowledgement and can finish before the background write. No later completion invalidates it.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future isolated fixture: return old history on acknowledgement invalidation, commit a new worker row later, then advance status polls while retaining the mount. Summary can advance while trend/history remain old. No fixture or real polling was executed.
confirmedIssues.fix: Refresh history on evidenced poll completion/advanced last-success status, or adopt a bounded consistent refresh policy at the existing hook owner; preserve independent retained/error states.

confirmedIssues.title: History trend joins incompatible volume denominations
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Worker records each poll in its then-current gallon/liter unit. Chart discards row.unit and plots raw price_per_unit as one comparable series, with no denominator in axis/table alternative. A preference change can therefore produce an artificial price drop despite a constant provider quote.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future synthetic rows: 3.785411784 per gallon and 1 per liter for the same underlying quote. Current mapping plots unequal values and accessible table omits their units. Source mapping only was inspected.
confirmedIssues.fix: Preserve and label each source denomination or perform an explicit display-boundary normalization with complete source units; keep raw payload, dates, series and accessible alternative.

confirmedIssues.title: USD provider quotes are relabeled with arbitrary saved currency symbol
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Provider explicitly returns USD. Gas status/history omit currency, while formatCurrency simply prepends saved currency_symbol without exchange conversion. Summary, history and chart therefore label unchanged USD amounts as a different currency.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future isolated formatting case with USD 3.45 and saved symbol EUR/€: current formatter produces €3.45 without an exchange rate. No preferences were saved or changed here.
confirmedIssues.fix: Keep source ISO currency explicit and format the gas quote as USD, or introduce an authorized explicit conversion contract. Never infer ISO currency from a saved symbol or silently relabel the amount.
confirmedIssues.owner: gas currency integration and its three display adapters

confirmedIssues.title: Summary denominator follows current settings rather than retained price unit
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Worker current_price remains the numeric value in the unit used at its last successful poll. Status does not carry that unit. Brief independently reads current gas_unit (or defaults when unavailable), so settings changes/hydration failures can relabel a retained gallon quote as per liter, or vice versa.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future isolated source fixture: retained status current_price=3.785411784 from a gallon poll, settings later liter, no subsequent successful poll. Brief labels that same number per L although equivalent price is 1 per L. No setting/poll was performed.
confirmedIssues.fix: Attach the price's actual source denomination to the status snapshot and use it atomically; expose unavailable/retained settings rather than assuming a denominator from defaults.

confirmedIssues.title: History is silently limited to the newest 50 records
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Hook supplies no limit/offset. Handler defaults to LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0. Table pagination only slices the returned array, and chart uses that same array. Older records have no server-page navigation or explicit loaded-window/truncation disclosure.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future synthetic database fixture with 51 records: endpoint default includes 50; local Next only traverses those 50 and the oldest record never becomes reachable. No database fixture/API request was executed.
confirmedIssues.fix: Add actual server pagination with truthful result metadata and a separately declared chart scope, or explicitly communicate a newest-50 loaded window without implying complete history.

confirmedIssues.title: Mobile table removes efficiency without a reachable detail alternative
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Caller allow-list omits efficiency_mpg. Shared table applies hidden md:table-cell; caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable/renderExpanded. Unit remains in the visible price cell, but efficiency has no mobile route.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future native/synthetic row at 375px with efficiency 25: current cell is hidden and there is no caller-provided row detail. Source CSS/props only; no viewport was opened.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use the existing mobilePresentation full-detail owner or existing row expansion to retain every field, preserving stable tableId, sort/filter and pagination semantics.
needs: bounded mobile full-detail test and later native proof

confirmedIssues.title: Workspace vehicle picker implies vehicle-scoped global US prices
confirmedIssues.mechanism: /gas-price is in neither vehicle-disabled paths nor prefixes, so route scope returns vehicle=true. Header renders VehiclePicker although gas hooks/cache keys accept no selected vehicle and provider queries US average prices.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source evaluation of getWorkspaceRouteScope('/gas-price') yields range=false, vehicle=true. Future desktop fixture selecting different synthetic vehicles leaves identical global gas queries. No picker/preference/browser action occurred.
confirmedIssues.fix: Register this global route in the existing vehicle-disabled owner; do not invent vehicle-specific price filtering or duplicate controls.

confirmedIssues.title: Accepted schedule change does not reset the running ticker
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Start constructs the ticker once. SetPollInterval only changes the field returned by Status; running tick handling never resets it. Only the stop/resume branch resets it. UI can show Daily and successful configuration while cadence remains the original weekly interval.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future isolated worker clock test: start at 7d, call SetPollInterval('daily') while running without stop/resume, advance 24h. Existing ticker still uses 7d. No real ticker/provider or config submission was run.
confirmedIssues.fix: Have the existing worker loop apply validated interval updates safely to its ticker and verify status/config reflect actual scheduling, without adding competing timers in the frontend.
confirmedIssues.owner: gas worker integration; read-only finding outside this report's write authority

confirmedIssues.title: Gas mutations do not opt into the live-only request guard
confirmedIssues.mechanism: All three mutation calls omit requiresLiveMode. The client defaults it false; operational-mode guard returns immediately for false. Gas paths are absent from offline unsafe-write patterns. Controls disable only for pending/no status, not historical/offline mode; with retained status, an as_of page can attempt live polling/config writes.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future isolated request-boundary test in as_of mode: invoke gas hook mutation with its present options and verify the live-only guard does not reject before transport. No transport, paid poll or preferences were invoked here.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use the existing requiresLiveMode boundary and operational-mode disabled/reason APIs for gas commands; retain no-reconnect-queue defaults and truthful failure feedback.
confirmedIssues.owner: gas hooks and page/configuration command adapter

confirmedIssues.title: Both trend axes bypass shared scalable typography
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Both ticks use literal fontSize 10 rather than an existing typography/chart role informed by saved font scaling. This is a confirmed source-pattern issue, not a measured WCAG failure.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source inspection finds two fixed font-size declarations. Future 200% text/saved-font-scale chart verification must compare computed tick size and readability; not executed.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing chart typography/preference roles while preserving currency labels, axes and compact geometry.
needs: scoped typography regression and later native review
